decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has a page of its own in 2024 and fits the firm's announced location-based energy analytics direction, so management's investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.

Although it fell to a mere mention in 2024, the regional electricity calculator is central to the energy tariff offering after the gas and site-specific tools were dropped, so management will likely attribute weak results to temporary market volatility and persist.
The area definition tool underpins the regional calculators and margin analysis, so the sunk development costs and its role as shared infrastructure justify keeping it despite reduced visibility.
